question: The first South Asian Games were hosted by _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathmandu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first South Asian Games were hosted by **Kathmandu**, Nepal.
 
• The event took place in 1984 and marked the beginning of a series of multi-sport events aimed at fostering regional cooperation and sportsmanship among South Asian countries.
 
• Participating nations included India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, and Nepal.
 
• The South Asian Games are a biennial multi-sport event, with the host nation rotating among the member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The South Asian Games were formerly known as the South Asian Federation Games.
 
• The event is organized by the South Asia Olympic Council (SAOC), which was formed in 1983.
 
• The Games feature a wide range of sports, including athletics, swimming, boxing, football, and volleyball, among others.
 
• The objective of the South Asian Games is to promote peace, goodwill, and mutual understanding among the South Asian nations through sports.
 
• The Games have played a significant role in improving the standard of sports in the region and have provided a platform for athletes to showcase their talents.
